basis: The dashboard titled 'Global Energy Consumption by Source' lists consumption shares: Fossil Fuels (50%), Renewables (25%), Nuclear (15%), and Hydroelectric (10%). Fossil Fuels has the largest share (50%). The routing criterion is the largest global energy consumption category, which maps to the option 'Route Fossil Fuels to priority source monitoring'.
option_label: Route Fossil Fuels to priority source monitoring
